items.title: Security scanning and a disclosure policy
items.detail: Automated SAST, secret scanning and container scanning, plus a documented vulnerability-disclosure policy.

items.title: Wider automated test coverage
items.detail: Cover every Server Action, role boundary, cross-tenant access attempt and failure or rollback path.

items.title: Self-service account deletion
items.detail: Let people delete their account and correct their data beyond profile name and photo.

items.title: Scheduled reminders and unsubscribe management
items.detail: Scheduled reminders, delivery preferences and unsubscribe management for attendee emails.

items.title: Emails for team invitations and join requests
items.detail: Today these appear only on the team and ticket pages, with no email.

items.title: Independent penetration test
items.detail: A pen test and threat-model review before handling sensitive or regulated data.

items.title: One-time inbox verification for certificates
items.detail: Replace email-knowledge eligibility when certificates carry value or personal data.

items.title: Step-up sign-in for destructive actions
items.detail: Optional extra authentication for especially destructive organiser and super-admin operations.

items.title: Audited organiser exports
items.detail: Record the purpose and approval for organiser data exports.

items.title: Calendar feeds and calendar sync
items.detail: Calendar feeds and synchronisation with external calendars.

items.title: Import and export for events and rosters
items.detail: Tools to import and export events and attendee rosters.

items.title: Team registration for recurring series
items.detail: Today series stay individual, and their validators refuse team settings.

items.title: Attendance confirmation for series occurrences
items.detail: Needs an instance-scoped check, a per-occurrence Emails card and per-occurrence counts.

items.title: Hackathon events in webhooks
items.detail: New event types such as submission.submitted, submission.withdrawn and results.published, with minimal payloads.

items.title: Team actions in the mobile API
items.detail: Create, join and manage a team and looking for a team, plus team rosters in the machine API behind a separate credential.

items.title: Submissions and judging in the mobile API
items.detail: Entrant submissions and judging management, with published results in the machine API behind a separate credential.

items.title: Crew in the mobile and machine APIs
items.detail: The crew list, food summary and crew flag. Today crew tickets show up as ordinary confirmed registrations.

items.title: Attendance confirmation in the mobile API
items.detail: Guest DTO field, People filter, send, remind and share-link actions, and the check-in desk badge.

items.title: Machine API for concrete consumers
items.detail: Series and instances, RSVP workflow data, scoped contact data, privacy-preserving feedback reads and narrow idempotent writes.

items.title: Separate worker processes
items.detail: Replace the in-process outbox worker that each application instance runs.

items.title: Load and soak testing
items.detail: Test with documented capacity targets.

items.title: Automated restore verification
items.detail: Automated restore checks and disaster-recovery exercises.

items.title: Tenant retention policies
items.detail: Configurable retention for registrations, feedback and audit history.

items.title: Consent and policy-version records
items.detail: Only where legally required.

items.title: Cross-event and organisation analytics
items.detail: Analytics with privacy-preserving aggregation.

items.title: Custom domains and organisation themes
items.detail: Organisation logos and per-event accent colours already exist.

items.title: Custom roles and per-action permissions
items.detail: More granular roles than the current set.

items.title: Automation for attendance confirmation
items.detail: For example a suggested send time, and only if organisers ask for it. It is deliberately manual today.

items.title: Design the remaining screens
items.detail: Create series flow, page content editor, feedback form builder and invites are not yet designed.

items.title: SLOs and multi-region planning
items.detail: Queue-depth, latency, object-store and email-delivery SLOs, and multi-region or read-replica planning if traffic needs it.
